dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus, following a consistent parabolic trajectory.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle asymmetrical bulge along the anterior-left lateral margin; otherwise smooth margins.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white baseline with high overall reflectance and low median pixel intensity variance.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse grey-pixel clusters localized primarily in the mid-dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between residual grey pigmented areas and the white baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A prominent, high-contrast vertical linear scar along the central axis; a secondary, lower-contrast linear mark on the upper-left dorsal quadrant.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible longitudinal indentation along the midline, creating a subtle shadow contrast.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed vertical linear scar on the central dorsal ridge.
